prompt: Find the surface area of a $2 \times 3 \times 4$ rectangular prism.
hint: Opposite faces of a rectangular prism match. So there are only three different rectangles to find.

hints.text: Opposite faces of a rectangular prism match. So there are only three different rectangles to find.
The three rectangles have areas $2 \times 3 = 6$, $2 \times 4 = 8$ and $3 \times 4 = 12$. Add them and then double.
$2(6 + 8 + 12) = 2 \times 26 = 52$, so the surface area is $52$ square units.

explanation: List the three different faces: $2 \times 3 = 6$, $2 \times 4 = 8$ and $3 \times 4 = 12$.
Add these three areas together to cover half of the prism: $6 + 8 + 12 = 26$.
Each face appears twice on the prism, so double the sum: $2 \times 26 = 52$.
The surface area of the prism is $52$ square units.
